title: The net force is every force on an object added together
summary: When several forces act on one object, they add, and that total is the net force.
body: OpenStax Physics says that when multiple forces act on an object, the forces combine. Adding all of them gives the total force, also called the net force. An outside force is one that comes from outside the chosen system. The section treats force as a vector, so direction matters when the forces are added. Urone and Hinrichs, 26 March 2020. The page is a textbook account of how to add forces, not a measurement.
